recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No current core source edit is needed for FHIR-23768; any future Device scope changes should be tracked as new OO decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-23768 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 by OO. It asked to correct the Device resource description because it still described Device as an administrative resource while DeviceComponent modeled physical parts, even though DeviceComponent had been removed and Device itself needed to describe physical units and module hierarchies linked through parent.
initial_application: Commit 334268c12b164fb910884605255cf3da17132c17, titled FHIR-23768, replaced source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml's Device description with the requested physical-unit/module/parent wording. The earlier Device updates commit a7f2575daae7bbacd9a22ea439c7ec35a4784f96, which listed FHIR-24936, had already rewritten the Device Scope and Usage and Boundaries narrative away from the old DeviceComponent split.
additional_context: FHIR-23768's Jira resolution says the issue was considered applied through FHIR-24936, the broader healthcare-product scope/boundary update. FHIR-24936 is already represented on the combined branch by commit 3660ffb8c59b7289a2a01dfa5ec99004df4fbeca, so no duplicate related audit was published. source/fhir.ini lists Device as active and approved while DeviceComponent appears only in commented/retired entries.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml contains the requested Device description with spelling corrected, and source/device/device-introduction.xml describes Device instance/component and parent relationships without the obsolete DeviceComponent contrast.
